description: This Java class 'VertxCoapResource' acts as a wrapper around a CoapResource to facilitate integration with the Vert.x framework. It delegates all resource operations to the underlying resource and ensures that request handling occurs within the specified Vert.x context.

classes.name: VertxCoapResource
classes.description: A wrapper class for a CoapResource that integrates with Vert.x, delegating all method calls to the wrapped resource and executing handleRequest on the specified Vert.x context.

methods.name: VertxCoapResource
methods.description: Constructor that wraps a CoapResource and associates it with a Vert.x context.

methods.name: getContext
methods.description: Returns the Vert.x context associated with this wrapper.

methods.name: handleRequest
methods.description: Delegates the incoming Exchange request to the wrapped resource, ensuring execution within the Vert.x context.

methods.name: getChild
methods.description: Retrieves a child resource by name from the wrapped resource.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Gets the name of the resource.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the resource.

methods.name: getURI
methods.description: Returns the URI of the resource.

methods.name: isVisible
methods.description: Indicates whether the resource is visible.

methods.name: isCachable
methods.description: Indicates whether the resource is cacheable.

methods.name: isObservable
methods.description: Indicates whether the resource is observable.

methods.name: getChildren
methods.description: Returns the collection of child resources.
